standard-dialogue.npc: Hey, down there! What is it?

steps.npc: For the dragons, of course! I've always wanted to slay dragons. I've found they're a bit tough, though, even with all this kit I've got, but I'll slay them one day.

steps.text: If the player has not completed Monkey Madness II:

steps.npc: My little cousin is a Slayer Master, lucky girl. But one day I'll be a mighty dragon-slayer, and they'll give me a job like that too.

steps.text: If the player has completed Monkey Madness II:

steps.npc: My little brother became a Slayer Master recently. That job should have been mine - he's just a little brat! But one day I'll be a mighty dragon-slayer, and they'll give me a job like that too.

options.text: Can I kill the dragons in here?

steps.player: Can I kill the dragons in here?

steps.text: If the player has bronze, iron or steel dragons as a slayer task:

steps.npc: Yes, certainly, since you've been assigned to do so.

steps.text: If the player does not have bronze, iron or steel dragons as a slayer task:

steps.npc: No, you haven't got an assignment to slay these dragons. Go and train somewhere else.

when-attempting-to-kill-monsters-that-ar.npc: I'm sure that's not what you're meant to be slaying.
